papers.title_en: Multimodal pseudo-CT synthesis for PET attenuation correction using separate modality encoding and topogram conditioning
papers.authors: Rory Bell, Artemis Bouzaki, Jiaming Cao, Jasmine Morrison, Chelsea Sargeant
papers.evidence: PET/MRI神经影像的深度多模态学习衰减校正
papers.tldr: 针对PET衰减校正中CT图像不可用的问题，我们提出多模态三维补丁U型网络，结合NAC-PET、MRI和二维定位图合成伪CT。模型采用独立编码器分别处理PET与MR，并通过FiLM层将定位图条件注入瓶颈，实现多尺度特征融合。在BIC-MAC挑战中验证，该方法能有效整合跨模态互补信息，同时降低对模态间精确体素配准的依赖。
papers.abstract_en: We participated in the BIC-MAC Challenge with a multimodal 3D patch-based U-Net for pseudo-CT generation from NAC-PET, MRI, and 2D topograms. By using separate PET and MR encoders, multi-scale feature fusion, and FiLM-based topogram conditioning at the bottleneck, we obtain a model that integrates complementary cross-modal information while reducing reliance on precise voxel-wise correspondence between modalities. Our final submission can be found: https://github.com/rrr-uom-projects/BIC-MAC-MICCAI2026

papers.title_en: Label-Free Foundational Model Selection for Medical Image Classification under Distribution Shift via Pseudo Label Discrepancy
papers.authors: Juan Iñaki Larrea, Lucas Mansilla, Enzo Ferrante
papers.evidence: 面向医学图像分类的基座模型选择，适用于神经影像AI场景
papers.tldr: 基础模型在医学图像分类中面临跨机构分布偏移，部署时性能难以预知且目标域无标签。本文提出基于伪标签差异的标签无关选择标准AURCC，通过分区计算类别污染程度，无需目标标注或微调即可排序候选模型。在胸部X光三组跨院场景的多种视觉语言模型上，AURCC排序与真实排序的Spearman rho最高达0.943，在源域数据较小时优于基于源准确率的基线。为无标签目标域下的基础模型选择提供了有效且低成本的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are increasingly deployed for medical image analysis. However, under the inter-institutional distribution shift typical of deployment, their performance varies widely and cannot be known without target-domain labels, which are rarely available. This leaves a practical question unresolved: given several candidate foundational models and labeled-data from a source domain, which one to deploy in an unlabeled target domain? We propose a label-free selection criterion built on SUDO, a framework for evaluating clinical AI systems without ground-truth annotations. SUDO partitions the unlabeled target data by predicted probability and, for each region, measures a pseudo-label discrepancy reflecting class contamination; aggregated across regions, this yields a score (AURCC) requiring neither target annotation nor fine-tuning. We show that AURCC can be used to rank a variety of vision-language models (BioMedCLIP, CXR-CLIP, CheXzero, MedCLIP, MedImageInsight, CLIP) on chest X-ray classification across three inter-hospital shift scenarios, under zero-shot and MLP-probe regimes. The AURCC ranking recovers the ground-truth ranking with Spearman rho up to 0.943 (p<0.05). Against the natural baseline of ranking by held-out source accuracy, AURCC is competitive when the labeled source is large and yields a more accurate ranking once it is small; the regime of interest in resource-constrained settings.

papers.title_en: Joint Causal Structure and Cluster Discovery Using Variational Inference
papers.authors: Avni Rajpal, Anubhav Kumar, Rishabh Karnad, Mohammad Emtiyaz Khan, P. K. Srijith
papers.evidence: 面向脑影像应用联合推断因果结构与隐聚类，可用于功能连接建模
papers.tldr: 因果发现通常研究单个变量间的关系，但在脑成像、气候建模等应用中，更有意义的是变量组间的交互。现有方法假设已知分组或聚类，然而实际中聚类及其间的因果结构都是潜在的。本文提出一种基于变分推断的联合学习方法，同时推断潜在聚类和因果结构；通过类别分布和伯努利分布建模后验，推导变分下界及参数估计。在合成和真实数据上验证了聚类与因果发现的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery aims to understand the relationships between individual random variables. In many applications, such as brain imaging and climate modeling, it is more meaningful to consider interactions among groups of variables. Existing methods assume that knowledge of such groups or clusters is explicitly available when modeling interactions. However, in practice, these clusters as well as the causal relationships among them, are latent. In this paper, we present a novel approach based on variational inference to simultaneously infer both the latent clusters and causal structures. We learn an approximate posterior over clusters and graph-structure by considering variational distributions based on categorical and Bernoulli models respectively. We derive variational lower bounds and estimation techniques to learn variational and model parameters. The effectiveness of our proposed methods for cluster and causal discovery are demonstrated on both synthetic and real data sets.

papers.title_en: Empirical-Bayes Elastic-Net Computation for Exponential Random Graph Models
papers.authors: Dan Han, Vicki Modisette, Ting Li, Akidul Haque
papers.evidence: 面向图数据的统计网络建模方法，可迁移到脑连接组推断，但并非神经影像专用
papers.tldr: 指数随机图模型在似然难处理且候选统计量强相关时推理困难。为此提出BERGM Elastic Net，一种自适应经验贝叶斯方法，将lasso收缩与岭稳定结合进贝叶斯框架，通过潜变量形式支持近似交换抽样。经验贝叶斯更新根据观测网络自动调整正则化量，并与弹性网络惩罚似然建立联系，澄清了阈值化报告与系数分组的解释。该方法可有效处理包含大量相关结构和协变量效应的过指定网络模型。
papers.abstract_en: Exponential random graph models (ERGMs) describe dependence among network ties, but inference becomes difficult when the likelihood is intractable and candidate network statistics are strongly correlated. We introduce BERGM Elastic Net, an adaptive empirical-Bayes approach that combines lasso shrinkage with ridge stabilization in a Bayesian ERGM. A latent-variable formulation supports approximate exchange sampling, while empirical-Bayes updates adapt the amount of regularization to the observed network. We connect the proposed prior to elastic-net penalized likelihood and clarify the interpretation of thresholded reporting and coefficient grouping. The method is developed for over-specified network models containing many related structural and covariate effects.
